node.label: hereditary spastic paraplegia 2
node.definition: Spastic paraplegia type 2 (SPG2) is an X-linked leukodystrophy characterized primarily by spastic gait and autonomic dysfunction. When additional central nervous system (CNS) signs, such as intellectual deficit, ataxia, or extrapyramidal signs, are present, the syndrome is referred to as complicated SPG.
synonyms: hereditary spastic paraplegia caused by mutation in PLP1

evidence.snippet: Disease-causing germline mutation(s) in (Assessed) — proteolipid protein 1
PLP1 is annotated as disease gene of OMIM:312920 (HPO genes_to_phenotype, OMIM-derived)
Mutations in the PLP1 gene cause various X-linked hereditary spastic paraplegias phenotypes, including Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease and spastic paraplegia type 2.
